description: Arbolado Urbano is the census of trees and tree-like plants on urban land in Bogotá, covering the biotypes tree, shrub, palm and tree fern. The Jardín Botánico de Bogotá José Celestino Mutis maintains it and publishes it on the Datos Abiertos Bogotá portal, where it has been listed since November 2019 and was updated in September 2026, and on the IDECA spatial data infrastructure as a map viewer. Coverage is the urban area of Bogotá D.C. Format and access: shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage and KMZ downloads plus WMS, WFS and Esri REST services, and an interactive map. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: the attribute fields were not listed on the page read, and trees on rural land are outside the census. It supports urban heat, landslide and storm-damage exposure studies and green infrastructure planning for one of Latin America's largest cities. Related catalogue records are the Bogotá urban parks property inventory and the Madrid municipal tree inventory.
